Hi there! What information do you need about the CS Department?
The Computer Science Department focuses on AI, Data Science, and Software Engineering. It offers B.Tech and M.Tech programs accredited by AICTE.
Our Head of Department is Dr. R. Sharma. Faculty details can be found at: csdept.university.edu/faculty
Labs operate from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday. Each lab is equipped with high-end systems for project work.
Exam timetables are released one week before exams on the departmental notice board and website.
Core courses include Data Structures, Operating Systems, DBMS, and Machine Learning. Electives include Cloud Computing and Cyber Security.
You can reach us at csdept@university.edu or call +91-9876543210.
Admissions are conducted through the state entrance exam. Visit university.edu/admissions for details.
The CS Department ranked top 3 in the region and students frequently qualify for GATE and research fellowships.
